steps.content: Witnessed by you and the old woman, Yanyan sits cross-legged under the tree, takes a few deep breaths, and slowly closes her eyes.

In your perception, the girl's special power is fluctuating rapidly. The power is very unstable and keeps varying in intensity, so much so that even Yanyan herself feels it too, furrowing her brow while keeping her eyes shut.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Wh-what happened?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yanyan is capable of channeling. She's calling upon all of her power to help you. Please give her a little time.
The old woman is completely confused, but Yanyan's efforts and goodwill are not lost on her. She stands aside, nervously clutching her handkerchief.
You quietly focus your mind on the shackles, feeling the fluctuations from the other end, paying close attention to Yanyan's state.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Great Seer, I've missed you, and I've got so many questions for you. I... there's too much I still need to do, but I don't know how.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I only need to offer my power to the Sun Crow? I see... I'm coming, I'll listen to you...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't go! It's a trap!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: No, it shouldn't be like this... The Almighty Bow is supposed to seal the Sun Crow with a single arrow. That should have done it.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...Am I not powerful enough?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Where's the bow? Let me try again! No, we need to make another one. Quick, I...

It's as if the disasters Yanyan fears the most are happening all at once on the other end of the shackles. The storms, floods, and earthquakes... are signs of the turmoil in the girl's heart. The more she tries to suppress them, the more uncontrollable the emotions become.
Finally, Yanyan snaps her eyes open, sweating profusely as if she just narrowly escaped from a disaster.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yanyan!
You try to shoulder some of the pain through the shackles for Yanyan, while the old woman pulls Yanyan into her arms. She pats Yanyan's back, tears streaming down her own face.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Stop, that's enough. You don't need to do this for me. It's not worth it...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: What do you mean it's not worth it? Of course, it's worth it!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: What's one failure? Let's do it again! I'm going to fulfill your wish, Granny!
Having said this with determination, Yanyan wipes the sweat from her face and sits back down under the tree, closing her eyes to regulate her breathing.
You know that Yanyan needs your assistance now more than ever.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Apostles of Ashes are products of concentrated Mania, a material projection of collective consciousness. They manifest themselves in this world, in the forms of disasters and Wraith Beasts.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Hypercubes don't exist in Eastia. Facing the Apostle, people could only rely on their faith in the Sun Shot legend. In other words, they were fighting the product of collective will with their collective will.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: When the Great Seer crafted the Almighty Bow, she was activating this immense spiritual power. Take it up upon you even as you know the truth beneath the lies. No matter how many times you fail, always have faith. This, Yanyan is surely capable of.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Ugh... Uh...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Just a little more... Yanyan can definitely do it...

Various intense and disorderly emotions gather on the other side of the shackles, prickling your head even though you're only sustaining part of them. Taking them all in, Yanyan must be enduring double the pain.
Sweat breaks out all over her forehead. Teeth clenched, her tense facial muscles twitch from time to time. Even her usually rosy cheeks gradually turn pale as time passes.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Sigh... She can't go on like this... We should give up. Let's not make the child suffer anymore...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Sorry, but even I can't be certain what will happen if we interrupt Yanyan now. Even to us, channeling is a delicate and unpredictable ability.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Now, we can only trust Yanyan. She must know about what she's doing.
Both you and the old woman are afraid that Yanyan will collapse from overexertion, but worry that intervening now might cause irreversible damage. In this dilemma, waiting becomes a torture.
Time ticks by. Just as the old woman can no longer bear such anxiety and simply closes her eyes and begins praying while fiddling with her bracelet, Yanyan opens her eyes.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Where... am I?

Rising golden light envelops Yanyan's body. Compared to the channeling you've seen before, it feels gentler this time, but the sense of sanctity is as strong as ever, making the girl look like a flower-hugging fairy.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: What, what's happening? What's wrong with Yanyan? Is she alright?! It looks like she's been...
You know the word she wants to say, and her guess is indeed not far from the truth.
With the connection of the shackles, you can clearly feel something as light as a wish note overlapping with the warm presence of Yanyan. The girl slowly lifts her head to look at the old woman.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Mom?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Is it you, Mom?

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Darling? Is it really you?
As if something is dawning on her, the old woman takes a few steps forward, her hands trembling, but then she hesitates and stops.

Understanding how unbelievable the situation is, the girl stands still as she searches for a way to help her mother recognize her. Pondering, she instinctively rubs her nose with the knuckle of her right index finger.
Capturing the familiar gesture, the woman shudders all over and finally rushes forward, embracing the girl in her arms.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: It's you! It's really you! My baby, my darling! You've finally come back!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Mom, did you come to see me? You look so different from before.
The old woman sobs, holding her so tightly as if to rub her into her own flesh and blood, never to be parted again.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: I'm sorry. It's all my fault. I failed to protect you.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: If I had come home from work earlier that day, you wouldn't have... It's all my fault...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: What are you talking about, Mom? I would never blame you!

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: You... you don't hate me? All I cared about was work, and I neglected you... If only I had spent more time with you... That way, maybe you wouldn't have left me...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Mom, I never felt neglected. If it hadn't been for me, you wouldn't have had to work so hard, right?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Your job was tough on you. I understood. And you've always loved me in your own way.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: It's just a pity that I couldn't be your daughter for longer. There were so many games I wanted to play with you, so many stories I wanted to hear from you, but I couldn't...

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: It's the same for me. I have so much to say to you. Thankfully, we still have this chance...

The old woman wipes her moist eyes, squeezing out a smile. After the initial shock, she's regained her strength. Unwilling to waste the precious reunion on sadness and remorse, she chooses instead to make up for her past regrets.
Cakes, the bracelet, aliens... The two of them snuggle together and chat about the bits and pieces of life, as if time and death never separated them.
However, this scene doesn't last long before the golden light on Yanyan begins to fade gradually.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Why is the light dimming... Darling, are you leaving?

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: But I've still got so many things to show you and tell you...

Watching the golden light pulsate and dwindle, the old woman seems helpless. She turns around to rummage through a stack of photos and reports, her hands trembling as she hands them to her daughter one by one.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Look, this is the serpentine alien you've done a lot of research on. I went to see it on your twenty-seventh birthday, and I also took pictures...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Mom, we don't have much time left.
The golden light flickers unsteadily, but the girl's face remains as gentle as ever.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Besides these, don't you have anything else to ask me, Mom?

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: ...Yes, of course, I do, darling! On your behalf, I've been on a search for aliens for years, and I've traveled to all the places you mentioned you wanted to go in your diary.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: But that birthday wish you wanted to tell me, I still don't know what it was... Can you tell me?
The old woman grabs the girl's hand and stares at her eagerly, asking in an almost pleading tone. With each pulsation of the light, she grips her hand tighter.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: That wish doesn't matter anymore, Mom. Because you've already fulfilled it for me.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Now, all I wish is...

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Darling?! No, don't go! Don't leave me, please!
As the golden light pulsates for the last time, the girl's words also dissipate into the air like mist.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: For you to live each day safely, healthily, and happily.

The world quiets down. The light, just like the girl who borrowed Yanyan's body, has vanished as if it's never appeared. Everything has returned to normal. Only the wind still rustles the notes on the wishing tree.
Yanyan has returned to her usual self, but the old woman is still holding her tightly, as if trying to grasp something with this persistent posture.
The lively girl also maintains a rare silence, like she's aware that she's the only one who can soothe the old woman's almost overflowing sorrow.

After a long while, Yanyan clumsily stretches out her small hand and gently pats the old woman's back, mimicking how adults always comfort her. This action seems to startle her, prompting her to break the silence.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Thank you, Yanyan.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: It's what I should do, Granny.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I'm a seer from Eastia. It's my duty and mission to grant people their wishes with my power and bring hope and courage to everyone.
Tenderly, Yanyan reaches out to wipe the silent tears from the old woman's cheeks.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Also, I was only able to help you see your daughter because she was also trying her best.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: For an ordinary person, Yanyan can only sense and connect with their emotions, regrets, or memories if they are particularly deep and intense. And I can't last long.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I'm sorry, Granny. I wanted to hold on a bit longer too, but right now I'm not yet a worthy seer. I can only do so much.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Don't say that, sweetheart. I'm too old to understand all these big words like seer and Eastia and so on. But thanks to you, I've got my hope and courage.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: My wish for many years has also been fulfilled. So, to me, Yanyan is the best seer.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Really? I'm so happy!
Yanyan's face lights up again. She jumps up and down happily for a moment, but quickly calms down and says to the old woman solemnly.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: But Granny, I must thank you too. Actually, before helping you, Yanyan messed up a lot of things and didn't know if I still had it in me.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Your story moved me so much. It made me want to help you. And it's through that I found back my abilities as a seer.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Now I understand. To be a good seer, you have to think like the person who makes the wish, to hope from the bottom of your heart, and to believe in the fulfillment of the wish.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Yanyan has grown up. And I will never ever forget this again!
Listening to Yanyan's serious reflection on what she's learned and her hope for the future, you can't help but show a relieved smile just like the old woman does.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It seems to me Yanyan has really grown up. I think there's an Eastian saying that goes you see someone in a new light after three days. For Yanyan, it shouldn't take more than three hours.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: At this rate, you would soon become a seer everyone can rely on.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Yes! Yanyan will become the best seer, just like Granny said!
Several days later.
Yanyan is going back to her hometown today. You get up especially early to see her off.
The petite girl is almost swallowed by her bulky luggage, which you know contains mostly DisCity specialties she is bringing back for her villagers. She seems much more at ease than before.
The uncertainty and doubt that once weighed her down have vanished. She seems like that cheerful and sincere girl you used to know again, yet something also seems different about her now.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, are you here to see me off?
Despite struggling with her luggage, she notices your arrival immediately and runs toward you with a big smile.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No, I came to observe someone tame their oversized luggage like a wild animal... Just kidding. Of course, I'm here to see you off.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I knew you would come, ${PlayerName}!
A bright smile blooms on Yanyan's face.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, do you remember the wish I made under the wishing tree? I even borrowed a coin from you!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I didn't tell you what it was at the time, but I've found all the answers to my questions already. So I can spill everything now!
She pauses for suspense, like a child about to proudly present their treasured possession.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I want to become the best seer ever! That was my wish!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're breaking it to me now? Won't that jinx it?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Hehe, Yanyan isn't afraid anymore! Because I will definitely make it happen. It's all up to me!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Everyone's wish and Yanyan's wish... Now I know that as long as we keep believing, they will all come true! Yanyan will make them come true!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I believe in you. By the time we meet again, you'll have definitely become the best seer there is.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: And you'll have become the best Chief there is, ${PlayerName}!
You exchange a glance and laugh together. Yanyan stretches out her hand, signaling you to copy her.
You lock your little fingers and bump your thumbs together. A pinky promise sealed with a stamp of the thumb.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: In Sunsink City, that's how we seal a promise! Come on, say it with me: Cross your pinkies, swear you won't regret it, not in a hundred years!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Let's do our best! We'll make it! Then I guess... I'll see you next time!
The girl waves at you one last time, then walks away with her bags of gifts.
Her figure is just as tiny and slender as before, but those small but firm shoulders are now capable of bearing responsibilities.
She turns and walks into the rising sun, advancing in her life and into her future.
